name: Fantasy
description: A season-long fantasy league where members draft TEAMS rather than players. Snake draft, weekly lineups that lock at each team's own kickoff, head-to-head matchups every week, and a scoring system the commissioner sets. Plays whatever competition the Picks season is — college football, the NFL, the NBA, MLB, the NHL or league football — and starts each league from that sport's own numbers, because a point is worth very different amounts in each. Every result is read from the fixtures and scores Picks already syncs, so nothing here needs a second data source.
author: Ernest Defoe
